chapterTitle: Chapter 12: How Much Can We Spend? 🪙
learningGoals: Recognize and identify basic coins and notes. 💵
Understand the concept of money and its use in buying things. 🛒
Match the price of a simple item with the correct coin or note. 🎯
Develop a basic understanding of spending and counting small amounts. 🐷
teachingTips: Show your child real coins and notes (like 1, 2, 5, 10 rupees) to help them feel and observe the differences. 🪙
Take them to a local shop and let them hand over the money for a small, safe purchase. 🏪
Talk about the prices of their favorite snacks to help them connect numbers with real-world value. 🍫
Praise their efforts and create a playful environment where they aren't afraid to make mistakes while counting money. 🎈

funActivities.title: Home Supermarket 🛒
funActivities.description: Set up a small shop at home using their toys or snacks. Label them with simple prices (1, 2, 5 rupees) and give them pretend or real coins to 'buy' the items.

funActivities.title: Coin Tracing Art ✏️
funActivities.description: Place a coin under a piece of paper and gently rub a pencil or crayon over it to reveal the coin's pattern. Discuss the number on the coin together!

funActivities.title: Piggy Bank Sorting 🐷
funActivities.description: Empty a small coin box and ask your child to sort the coins into different groups based on their shape, size, and the number written on them.
